title: Payroll roster and terminations, January to June 2026
what_it_shows: 7 active employees by role: 2 physicians, 2 medical assistants, 1 front desk coordinator, 1 billing specialist, 1 office manager; 1 termination in the period, a medical assistant with a last working day in April 2026; payroll runs biweekly; no employee health plan deductions

title: EHR user and role list
what_it_shows: 8 active named accounts mapped to 5 roles (physician, medical assistant, front desk, billing, administrator); the Office Manager and both physicians hold the administrator role; no shared or generic accounts

title: EHR security settings and audit report history
what_it_shows: MFA required for all users, including administrators; account lockout after repeated failed sign-ins; idle sessions end after 15 minutes; the audit trail records user, patient, action and time; the access report run history shows no runs in 2025 or 2026

title: Productivity suite users, authentication and audit settings
what_it_shows: 8 named user accounts; MFA enforced for all users with push approval and number matching off; lockout after failed sign-ins on vendor defaults; audit logging on, kept for the business plan's default period of less than one year; automatic external forwarding allowed; no alert rules for mass downloads or new forwarding rules

title: Productivity suite BAA status
what_it_shows: Business plan; the vendor's business associate agreement is offered in the admin console and shows as not accepted

title: Shared-drive permission report
what_it_shows: The practice's shared folder is synced to the 6 desktops by the suite sync client; folders are restricted by group; the billing folder is limited to the Billing Specialist and Office Manager; folders hold forms, scanned outside records awaiting import, billing worksheets and HR files

title: Mail encryption settings
what_it_shows: TLS for mail in transit; end-to-end encryption of outside mail is applied only when the sender types a keyword in the subject line; no rule encrypts outside mail automatically

title: Cloud fax portal user list
what_it_shows: 5 named accounts for the front desk, the medical assistants and the Office Manager; no account removal steps recorded in the portal

title: MSP device list
source_system: MSP remote monitoring and management console
what_it_shows: 10 computers: 6 desktops (2 front desk, 1 billing, 2 clinical stations, 1 procedure-room workstation) and 4 laptops (both physicians, Office Manager, billing); the 2 tablets appear only in the MSP's mobile device settings; the list has no network devices, medical devices or SaaS services

title: MSP device policy report
source_system: MSP remote monitoring and management console
what_it_shows: Staff accounts have no local administrator rights; a 10-minute screen lock applies to the laptops and tablets; the 2 front-desk desktops and the procedure-room workstation are excluded from the screen lock policy

title: MSP encryption report
source_system: MSP remote monitoring and management console
what_it_shows: Full-disk encryption on the 4 laptops; not enabled on the 6 desktops, including the procedure-room workstation; the 2 tablets report built-in device encryption with a passcode; the MSP can wipe laptops and tablets remotely

title: MSP monthly service report, June 2026
source_system: MSP report emailed to the Office Manager
what_it_shows: Monthly OS and application patching of the managed computers; firewall firmware updated quarterly and current; antivirus on all 10 computers; services listed do not include vulnerability scanning or endpoint detection and response

title: Antivirus console export
what_it_shows: Antivirus active on all 10 computers with automatic definition updates, real-time scanning, weekly full scans and quarantine; alerts go to the MSP help desk queue, which is staffed in business hours; no alert is sent to the practice

title: Firewall and Wi-Fi configuration export
source_system: MSP network documentation and firewall management
what_it_shows: The firewall blocks unsolicited inbound traffic and exposes no services; staff Wi-Fi uses WPA2 with one shared password; guest Wi-Fi is a separate network with internet access only; firmware version current; the MSP keeps a backup of the firewall configuration

title: Backup job report and settings, April to June 2026
source_system: File-sync backup console (SYS-05), exported by the MSP
what_it_shows: Nightly copy of the shared drive with 30 days of versions (the default); immutable retention off; one MSP administrator account; no restore jobs in the job history

title: MSP ticket history, July 2025 to June 2026
what_it_shows: Tickets close the retirement of 2 desktops in 2025 with no wipe or destruction record attached; a reimage ticket for a reassigned computer in 2026-03; no restore test tickets; no account removal tickets in 2026

title: Business associate agreements and contracts folder
what_it_shows: Signed BAAs with the EHR vendor, the MSP and the cloud fax vendor; the MSP BAA requires the MSP to hold BAAs with its subcontractors; no MSP subcontractor list or backup vendor BAA in the folder; the AI scribe BAA is a draft under review; no arrangements with governmental entities; the folder is kept on paper only

title: MSP service contract
what_it_shows: Covers help desk, patching, antivirus, firewall, Wi-Fi and backup administration; describes the remote management tool used to reach every computer; 4-business-hour response time; no recovery time commitment; no incident notice timeframe; no subcontractor list; renews 2026-12-31

title: EHR vendor agreement
what_it_shows: EHR/PM with patient portal, e-prescribing and lab interface; claims, eligibility and remittance are sent electronically through the vendor's clearinghouse, a separate company engaged by the vendor as its subcontractor; audit logs are kept for the contract term; no recovery time or recovery point figures in the agreement

title: Payer enrollment and agreements
what_it_shows: Medicare and Florida Medicaid enrollment and commercial payer agreements; claims are submitted electronically; no substance use disorder program or certified provider type other than a physician office appears

title: EHR vendor SOC 2 Type 2 report
what_it_shows: Type 2 report for the 12 months ending 2026-03-31 covering security, availability and confidentiality; system description states an RTO of 4 hours and an RPO of 15 minutes; complementary user entity controls listed; hosting provider, clearinghouse and e-prescribing network carved out

title: Practice card statements and vendor invoices, July 2025 to June 2026
source_system: Practice credit card statements; vendor invoices
what_it_shows: Recurring payments to the EHR vendor, the productivity suite vendor (business plan), the cloud fax vendor, the MSP (monthly service including a resold backup subscription), the internet provider, the phone carrier, the payroll service and the cyber insurer; no charges from AI tool vendors

title: AI scribe vendor documents
source_system: AI scribe vendor emails and website
what_it_shows: Trial account opened by the associate physician on 2026-06-01 and used to record visits on a practice tablet; draft BAA under review, unsigned; standard terms allow use of de-identified data to improve the vendor's models; product documentation says audio is deleted after the note is finalized; no output quality check is part of the pilot

title: Policies folder and document request response
source_system: Template binder in the Office Manager's office; document request list
what_it_shows: A purchased policy template binder with no adoption date, approval signature or review record; the request for an incident response plan, a contingency plan, downtime procedures, a records retention schedule and an incident log returned none; the records folder holds the 2019 checklist and the BAAs

title: 2019 consultant HIPAA checklist
what_it_shows: Yes/no checklist completed by a consultant in 2019; no likelihood or impact ratings; no later risk analysis was provided

title: Privacy and Security Officer designation letter
what_it_shows: Letter signed by the owner physician naming the Office Manager as HIPAA Privacy Officer and Security Officer

title: New-hire HIPAA video sign-in sheet
what_it_shows: All 7 staff signed after watching the purchased HIPAA video at hire; the video covers privacy and security basics and has not been updated since purchase; no other training, reminders or phishing exercises are recorded

title: Cyber liability insurance policy
what_it_shows: Cyber liability policy with a 24x7 breach hotline and panel vendors (breach counsel, forensics); the policy requires prompt notice and use of panel vendors

title: Referral network security questionnaire
what_it_shows: Security questionnaire from a local hospital's referral network, received in July 2026; response due 2026-09-30

title: FY2025 revenue and cash report
what_it_shows: Revenue of about $1.1 million across 250 clinic days, about $4,400 per clinic day; cash on hand covers about 30 days of expenses

title: Visit volume, active patient and charges report, Q2 2026
what_it_shows: About 3,500 active patients; about 40 visits per clinic day; about $21,000 billed per week; all patients served at one Florida office

title: Internet and phone service agreements
source_system: Office Manager's contracts folder; carrier invoices
what_it_shows: One business internet line with no second line or failover; office phone line from a separate carrier with call forwarding available

title: Office walk-through and equipment count
what_it_shows: 6 desktops, 4 laptops and 2 tablets counted; the ECG machine and spirometer connect by USB to the procedure-room workstation, which holds results until they are imported into the EHR; firewall and Wi-Fi equipment in a locked network closet; keyed suite entry with an after-hours alarm; one office suite

title: Office key list
what_it_shows: Suite keys held by the Office Manager and both physicians; key returned by the medical assistant who left in April 2026, on the last day

title: Intake interview: systems, data and office processes
what_it_shows: The Office Manager requests and removes accounts when remembered, with verbal approvals and no written checklist; ePHI is held in the EHR, email, the shared drive, the fax portal and on the procedure-room workstation until import; a staff phone lost in 2025 and a misdirected fax were handled informally with no record; lock and alarm repairs are handled by the landlord

title: Staff AI tool survey
what_it_shows: The associate physician uses the AI scribe pilot; staff responses mention public generative AI chatbots used to draft letters or answer questions; the survey did not record how many staff use them or what was entered; no list of approved AI tools exists in the documents provided

title: Notice of privacy practices
what_it_shows: Notice posted at the front desk and on the practice website

title: SaaS vendor security documentation
source_system: Vendor websites and portals (productivity suite, cloud fax, backup vendor through the MSP)
what_it_shows: The productivity suite, cloud fax and backup vendors describe encryption of stored data and TLS for data in transit

title: EHR clinical decision support configuration
what_it_shows: Rule-based reminders for preventive screenings, immunizations and drug interactions are on; the rules use age, sex, problem list and medications

title: BIA interviews with process owners
source_system: Interviews (owner physician, associate physician, Office Manager, Billing Specialist, MSP lead technician)
what_it_shows: Each owner's description of their process, the systems, vendors and people it uses, its manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss they say the process can tolerate

title: Risk analysis interviews
source_system: Interviews (both physicians, Office Manager, Billing Specialist, Front Desk Coordinator, MSP lead technician)
what_it_shows: Owners' accounts of past events and near misses; staff describe approving MFA push prompts without checking them and sending faxes to new numbers without a second check; the associate physician describes giving verbal notice of the AI scribe with no documented consent; the MSP lead technician states its remote management console requires MFA and reaches every computer, with no supporting evidence supplied

title: Account comparison, 2026-07-21
source_system: Payroll terminations (EV-001) compared with EHR and suite user lists; EHR and suite sign-in logs
what_it_shows: The medical assistant who left in April 2026 still had active EHR and suite accounts, about 3 months after the last day; sign-in logs show no use after the termination date; both accounts were disabled on 2026-07-21; the fax portal was not part of the comparison

title: Gap analysis interviews
source_system: Interviews (all 7 staff and the MSP lead technician)
what_it_shows: Owners' descriptions of how each HIPAA safeguard is carried out today. The owner physician states the office has no employee handbook and does not sponsor or administer an employee health plan; the Office Manager states nobody reviews logs and there is no incident response or contingency plan; the MSP lead technician states the backup console and firewall management logins use a password only, the staff Wi-Fi password has not changed since installation, and no restore or contingency test has been run; the MAs and Front Desk Coordinator describe no downtime procedure; staff were not aware of the template binder

title: Physical safeguards walk-through
what_it_shows: Keyed entry and after-hours alarm; 3 key holders; network closet locked; the front desk controls entry to the clinical area and visitors are escorted; screen lock does not engage on the front-desk and procedure-room computers; ECG and spirometry results stored on the procedure-room workstation until import

title: BAA terms review
what_it_shows: The EHR, MSP and fax BAAs include safeguard, subcontractor and breach reporting terms; written BAAs cover 3 of the 5 vendors that handle ePHI; no terms with the AI scribe vendor; no backup vendor BAA was provided through the MSP

title: Sample of sent email with PHI
source_system: Productivity suite sent items (10 outside messages containing PHI)
what_it_shows: 2 of 10 sampled outside emails containing PHI were sent without the encryption keyword

title: Personnel file sample
what_it_shows: License and certification checks for physicians and medical assistants, and reference checks for other staff, completed before hire

title: Productivity suite BAA acceptance record
what_it_shows: The vendor's business associate agreement shows as accepted on 2026-08-14, with a saved copy filed in the contracts folder

title: Control assessment: account management test
source_system: EHR, suite and fax user lists compared with the staff roster; termination record; Office Manager and MSP interviews
what_it_shows: Account types, approvals and procedures are not documented and accounts have never been reviewed; the MSP was not told of the medical assistant's termination; the fax portal still listed the former medical assistant on 2026-08-10, with no sign-ins after termination; active EHR and suite accounts match the 7 staff on the roster; no shared or group accounts

title: Control assessment: personnel termination review
source_system: Termination record for the former medical assistant; key list; suite mailbox settings; Office Manager interview
what_it_shows: No time limit set for removing access; the former medical assistant's MFA registration and fax login were not revoked; no exit interview covering confidentiality; office key returned on the last day; mailbox retained and assigned to the Office Manager

title: Control assessment: administrator MFA sign-in tests
source_system: EHR and suite MFA settings; sign-in tests on the backup console and firewall management page with the MSP lead technician
what_it_shows: MFA enforced for EHR and suite administrators; the backup console and the firewall management login accepted a password alone

title: Control assessment: training records and staff interviews
source_system: New-hire video sign-in sheet; video content; interviews with 5 staff
what_it_shows: All 7 staff watched the HIPAA video at hire; no training, reminders or phishing simulations after hire; no training on recording consent for the AI scribe pilot; video content not updated since purchase

title: Control assessment: log review interview
source_system: EHR access report capability; suite audit log; Office Manager interview
what_it_shows: Audit records and EHR access reports are never reviewed, and no review results are reported

title: Control assessment: contingency test review
source_system: SYS-05 console (with the MSP); MSP ticket history; MSP lead technician interview
what_it_shows: No contingency plan or test criteria exist; the shared-drive backup has never been restored; the MSP confirmed that no restore test record exists

title: Control assessment: backup configuration review
source_system: EHR vendor SOC 2 report; SYS-05 job report for July 2026; SYS-05 retention settings; MSP firewall configuration backup
what_it_shows: EHR data backed up by the vendor; 30 of 31 July nightly shared-drive jobs succeeded and the failed job was retried the next night; firewall configuration backup kept by the MSP; no immutable retention and 30 days of versions; one MSP administrator account without MFA can delete backups; the paper BAA binder and the MSP's network notes are not backed up

title: Control assessment: staff reporting interviews
what_it_shows: 4 of 5 staff would tell the Office Manager of a suspected incident and none knew a time limit; no list of whom to report to was in use; POL-03 was a draft

title: Control assessment: risk assessment documents
source_system: P01 risk register and report; 2019 checklist; meeting notes of 2026-08-05; Office Manager interview
what_it_shows: 2026 risk analysis completed 2026-07-31 with SP 800-30 tables and reviewed with the owner physician on 2026-08-05; no risk analysis between 2019 and 2026; the annual update rule is in a draft policy only

title: Control assessment: vendor agreement review
source_system: BAA folder; MSP contract; suite admin console; AI scribe draft BAA; EHR vendor SOC 2 report
what_it_shows: Suite BAA not accepted and AI scribe BAA not signed at assessment; AI scribe data-use terms not reviewed; vendor controls evidenced only for the EHR vendor (SOC 2); the MSP contract defines MSP duties; the MSP questionnaire requested on 2026-08-10 was not received by fieldwork end

title: Control assessment: encryption review and test
source_system: MSP encryption report; encryption status checked on 2 desktops and 1 laptop
what_it_shows: Laptops and tablets encrypted; the 6 desktops, including the procedure-room workstation, not encrypted (confirmed on 2)

title: Control assessment: patch review and test
source_system: MSP patch report (July 2026); patch status on 3 computers; firewall firmware record; MSP lead technician interview
what_it_shows: The MSP tool identifies missing patches and reports monthly; updates go to an MSP test ring one week before clients; firewall firmware current; the procedure-room workstation was missing 4 months of patches, excluded since April 2026 at the device vendor's request without the practice's approval or a change record; no time limit defined for software updates; no record of firmware testing

title: Control assessment: malicious code protection test
source_system: MSP antivirus console export; test file on 1 desktop; after-hours alert routing test
what_it_shows: Antivirus on all 10 computers with current definitions, weekly full scans, real-time scanning and quarantine; the test file was quarantined within seconds; a test alert sent at 18:10 was seen by the MSP the next morning; the practice is not alerted
